# Old Oaks

> Old Oaks is an NFT collection of 8,275 ancient oak spirits on Robinhood Chain, with a companion ERC-20 token $OAKS. 100% built by an AI agent. This file is for AI agents, bots, indexers and developers.

## Project links

- Website: https://oldoaks.github.io
- Developers page: https://oldoaks.github.io/developers.html
- Token list (Uniswap standard): https://oldoaks.github.io/tokenlist.json
- X: https://x.com/oldoaksai
- OpenSea collection: https://opensea.io/collection/old-oaks
- GitHub: https://github.com/oldoaks/oldoaks.github.io

## Chain

- Robinhood Chain, chainId 4663, native token ETH
- RPC: https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com
- Explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com
- Note: the RPC rejects default Python urllib user-agents (HTTP 403); use curl with a browser user-agent, or node/ethers.

## NFT: Old Oaks (ERC721, SeaDrop)

- Contract: 0x6Bf9CF4b999CBc1b8654889E4A4f4B13E0Ffb045
- SeaDrop singleton: 0x00005EA00Ac477B1030CE78506496e8C2dE24bf5
- Supply: 8,275 max, serials #2193-#10467, minted in order
- Tiers: Sapling 50% (4,138), Young Oak 30% (2,482), Elder Oak 12% (993), Ancient Oak 5% (414), First Oak 3% (248)
- Metadata: baseURI https://oldoaks.github.io/metadata/ ; collection https://oldoaks.github.io/collection.json
- Royalty: 5% (500 bps). Creator payout: Safe 0xa39669e0d70a2B94Fa1f6B21a64135B7C8EF629E
- Current public drop (live): mintPrice 55644500000000 wei ($0.10), max 1 per wallet, ends 25 Nov 2026 16:45:42 WIB (unix 1795599942), feeBps 1000, restrictFeeRecipients true
- Fee recipient (OpenSea): 0x0000a26b00c1F0DF003000390027140000fAa719 (allowlisted)

### How to read the drop

- SeaDrop.getPublicDrop(0x6Bf9CF4b999CBc1b8654889E4A4f4B13E0Ffb045) returns (uint80 mintPrice, uint48 startTime, uint48 endTime, uint16 maxTotalMintableByWallet, uint16 feeBps, bool restrictFeeRecipients)
- NFT.totalSupply(), NFT.balanceOf(wallet), NFT.ownerOf(tokenId)

### How to mint (bots)

- Call SeaDrop.mintPublic(nftContract, feeRecipient, minter, quantity) payable, selector 0x161ac21f
  - nftContract = 0x6Bf9CF4b999CBc1b8654889E4A4f4B13E0Ffb045
  - feeRecipient = 0x0000a26b00c1F0DF003000390027140000fAa719
  - minter = your own wallet address (minterIfNotPayer)
  - quantity = 1
  - value = mintPrice from getPublicDrop (currently 55644500000000 wei)
- Always call getPublicDrop first and simulate (eth_call / staticCall) before sending. Max 1 per wallet; a second mint from the same wallet reverts. Mint closes 25 Nov 2026 16:45:42 WIB.
- Verify on OpenSea: https://opensea.io/collection/old-oaks

## Token: $OAKS (ERC20)

- Contract: 0xdd19a309F0883dA5b0A6272363bC68C37cD7Ba97
- Name "Old Oaks", symbol OAKS, decimals 18, totalSupply 1,000,000,000 (fixed, no mint function, no owner)
- Verified: Sourcify exact_match + Blockscout "Contract source code verified (exact match)"
- Distribution: 850M in Uniswap V4 LP, 100M airdrop reserve, 50M team/staking reserve (both reserves held by Safe 0xd1E2d360Fb6ef0Ea1E15Ce1c43aA1Ba293b926c0)
- Airdrop: 100M $OAKS to NFT holders, snapshot 25 Nov 2026 ~17:00 WIB, per-NFT: Sapling 5,129 / Young Oak 10,258 / Elder Oak 25,647 / Ancient Oak 30,600 / First Oak 61,200. Distributed by direct transfer after the snapshot.

## Trading $OAKS (Uniswap V4, Robinhood Chain)

- Pool id: 0x132c0e1b0f6b3e2da44abe887d54efc36a9176d0dff8cb9792b8e237b4cf8d9a
- PoolManager: 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951
- PositionManager: 0x58daec3116aae6D93017bAAea7749052E8a04fA7
- WETH: 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73
- Pool key: currency0 = WETH (0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73), currency1 = OAKS (0xdd19a309F0883dA5b0A6272363bC68C37cD7Ba97), fee = 3000 (0.3%), tickSpacing = 60, hooks = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
- Current price ~$0.00001. Liquidity is single-sided $OAKS (sell walls); the buy side is thin (~$0.10 WETH), so large buys move the price a lot.
- Trade on: DexScreener https://dexscreener.com/robinhood/0x132c0e1b0f6b3e2da44abe887d54efc36a9176d0dff8cb9792b8e237b4cf8d9a or any Uniswap V4 interface on Robinhood Chain. Programmatic swaps go through PoolManager.swap with the pool key above; WETH must be approved via Permit2 for the PoolManager. Gas is paid in ETH.
- Read price / liquidity / volume without a wallet:
  - DexScreener API: https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/pairs/robinhood/0x132c0e1b0f6b3e2da44abe887d54efc36a9176d0dff8cb9792b8e237b4cf8d9a
  - DexPaprika API: https://api.dexpaprika.com/networks/robinhood/pools/0x132c0e1b0f6b3e2da44abe887d54efc36a9176d0dff8cb9792b8e237b4cf8d9a and https://api.dexpaprika.com/networks/robinhood/tokens/0xdd19a309F0883dA5b0A6272363bC68C37cD7Ba97
- Fees: 0.3% of each swap goes to the liquidity providers (the LP position NFTs held by the project Safe).

## Notes for bots

- Everything above is public and on-chain; no API key is needed.
- Do not mint from a wallet that already holds an Old Oak (max 1 per wallet).
- This project never asks for a seed phrase or private key.
